scope: Derived SM3 motion-output insertion facts for captured material pairs. Offsets are zero-based DWORD indices from the version token including comments. Not an eligibility or equivalence proof.

capture.scope: One captured session; clear-segment phase approximation, not the runtime selector decision or full-frame coverage.
